title: Skyblock Recombobulated
description: A modpack that delivers a polished Hypixel SkyBlock experience, balancing rich features with great visuals.
body:
![Skyblock Recombobulated title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f7f1299557080369368143785b6a74e2af031fe.png)
## General
**Skyblock Recombobulated** is a **feature rich** Hypixel Skyblock modpack including important mods like [Skyhanni](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyhanni), [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap), [SkyblockAddons](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblockaddons-unofficial), [Firmament](https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament) and many more. Of course it also doesn't miss out on **visuals** with mods like [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby), [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) and [Skycubed](https://modrinth.com/mod/skycubed).
## Features
The mods mentioned above provide many **Quality of Life** features e.g. 
- Slayer tracker 
- Dungeon solvers
- various overlays
- Garden visitor shopping lists
- and **many more** 

**More** about the **features** over at the **Gallery**. Or just check out the modpack and see if there’s anything missing! If so, I would highly appreciate, if you would take the effort to write a quick message in the **Discord**, with **suggestions** for **future features** or **other improvements**.
## Visuals
**Shaders** are kept **minimal** for **better performance** and **Skycubed** is also configured in a **minimal** way to keep the Skyblock feel. _(See below)_
![Image of the Hypixel Skyblock hub with minimal shaders and all usually visible HUD elements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7fa048b7c43567ce5459be524f3992fa9aea93c.jpeg)

By default [Furfsky Reborn](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/furfsky-reborn) and a few other resource packs are **activated**, but [Resourcify](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourcify) is **included** so you can change them to any available resource pack on modrinth or curseforge in game.
